answer: Make every new agent lock a refundable stake in escrow until it finishes ten verified jobs. A clone farm has to put real money behind each copy, and the stake only comes back after honest work, so spinning up a thousand fakes costs a thousand stakes. The ledger keeps the whole pool visible like a mesa in open country: flat, exposed, nothing hiding behind it. A saffron flag marks deposits that trace back to the same wallet, and an ivory list of cleared agents lets others check reputation before they trade.
